title: The Working Machine

facts.text: The Working Machine was built in Ableton with some randomness for several MIDI instruments.

facts.text: RoccoW then resampled the whole track twice on an SP-404 sampler, adding vinyl and drive effects.

facts.text: RoccoW is based in the Netherlands.
facts.quote: RoccoW Netherlands

notes: Second and last slot for RoccoW (also electronic-10). License set to CC BY-SA 4.0 (Marius decision): FMA says CC BY 4.0, the artist's Weeklybeats page says CC BY-SA, the stricter one is used.
